description: The Task Stream – Process Flow Chart is a powerful and intuitive Power BI custom visual designed to help businesses visualize task flows, milestones, and dependencies within projects. This visual enables users to track progress, identify bottlenecks, and improve task management efficiency. With a user-friendly interface, Task Stream allows for easy customization, including adjusting the number of milestones and tasks displayed, selecting colors, and modifying font sizes to enhance readability. This flexibility ensures that project managers and teams can tailor the view to meet their specific needs. Key Features Project-Based Views – Easily switch between projects to update the task flow visualization. Structured Task Order – Tasks are organized by milestones (parent tasks) and finish dates for clear process tracking. Customizable Colors – Choose specific colors for milestones and tasks to enhance visual clarity. Adjustable View – Control the number of milestones and tasks displayed at a time, ensuring better navigation and focus. Scalable Font Size – Modify the font size for improved readability based on the chart’s complexity. Business Use Cases Project Management & Agile Workflows: Helps project managers and teams track task progress, milestones, and dependencies in Agile or Waterfall methodologies.
